_comment: Captured 2026-08-08 from a real tdx.small CVM: guest image dstack-0.5.9, node prod5 (26) running dstack v0.5.7. NOT bundled reference data — the verifier ships OS image identity (name, os_image_hash, revoked) and no register values at all, so a boot reference can only be captured from a deployment you have independently satisfied yourself about. Re-capture if the guest image OR the node version changes; a reference that silently describes a different platform is worse than none.
